name: factors swapped
meaning: the side byte picks the other factor

name: whole side word
meaning: all 64 bits of the side argument decide the side

name: sell rounds up only off-tick
meaning: the sell side rounds up to the tick instead of adding a whole tick

name: round half even
meaning: Python round() (half to even) instead of half away from zero

name: decimals checked first
meaning: the decimals panic is checked before the market row checks

name: time ignores nanoseconds
meaning: the millisecond stamp drops the nanosecond word

name: tick digits minus four
meaning: the tick ladder starts one digit early

name: time not clamped
meaning: times before 1970 are not clamped to 0

name: kinds swapped
meaning: record +0x48/+0xdc constants of the other factor family

name: zero side still prices
meaning: one empty side still yields a price
